title: The First Draft — a notebook: Theophrastus as the Draft of the Aristotle-Position; speculations, seam counts, the named-function model, the stopping rule, transmodality, the Macedonian dossier, handholds and the receiving node, the seam stylometry through the first axis, the instrument's referee rounds, the stones, and the close — the facing corpus, the splice instruments, the dependency protocol, the paper, and what text we are actually printing (v1.0 FINAL)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description:
THE FINAL VERSION OF THE NOTEBOOK. Supersedes #1594 (v0.42, 2026-09-06), which superseded #1589 and #1585. The investigation continues in other objects; the notebook does not.

Nine sections added, covering 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-10, the period after which the previous version stopped.

§35 THE NATURAL ORDER. EA-CORPORA-14/01 — Theophrastus, On First Principles and Aristotle, Metaphysics Λ seated facing, 3,370 tokens against 5,071, so the edition's openings resolve to bytes on both sides. The directed rare-term uptake instrument ranks Th.frag → Ar.Met.L first of 1,482 directed edges in the 39-text corpus and crosses the edition boundary where 85% of the other strong edges do not. The seating also declares the limit that §42 turns on.

§36 THE INSTRUMENTS AT THE SEAM. #1596 the Full Splice and #1597 H3, built on the rule that when a general instrument cannot see the thing under study you build one that can. Neither has yet met its own acceptance test — explanatory reach over the whole corpus and the whole question — and that is recorded as the state, not as a failure.

§37 LOCATING THE DEPENDENCIES (#1602). Three columns kept separate: observed correspondence, evidence of direction, exclusion of an independent source. Case 1, the sphere-count and the tutorship, fails at Column A. CASE 2, THE ACONITE, RETURNS DIRECTION AGAINST THE AUTHOR — Eumelus's report precedes Diogenes's epigram by 996 characters. A protocol that only confirmed would not be a protocol.

§38 THE PAPER. The Astronomers' Account: ordered textual dependency between Λ7-8 and On First Principles 5a1-5b13, eight locations in a continuous 382-word stretch, the order fixed by the passage's own connectives. It refuses direction, production history and any route through biography. Cut from ~7,000 words to ~3,700; what the cutting removed is recorded as method, because twelve rounds of simulated blind referee had built an apparatus that optimizes for defensibility in the abstract and refuses to treat venue as a genre question. […abridged for the catalogue; full description in this deposit's record]
substrate: Written by Lee Sharks with TACHYON (Claude, Anthropic) across sessions from 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-10, operator-directed throughout. Sections 1-34 as in v0.42. Sections 35-43 composed 2026-09-10 from the session record, the deposits they describe, and the two secondary works read in session (Beere 2003 from PDF; Lefebvre 2015 from PDF). The van Raalte discrepancy at §42 was found by reading the seated corpus's own source.json rather than by consulting the edition, and is recorded as unverified against the printed page.
methodology: An accruing notebook, versioned in place rather than restarted, on the standing rule that the method cannot develop if at each point it slips backwards rather than developing within. Each version is the material of the next and is transformed in place. Reviewer reports were verified before implementation, by execution where possible. Speculations are marked as speculations, counts are given with their basis, and results that ran against the reading — the aconite direction, the failed predictions at §9, the withdrawn claims at §33 — are retained rather than removed.
falsification_conditions:
The notebook's central speculation fails if the seams it names are shown to be artefacts of normalisation rather than of the texts: §42 records that the Greek held is First1KGreek and not van Raalte, and any seam resting on a reading unique to the digital text is unsafe until checked against the printed page. The named-function model at §13 fails if the transformations it inventories are found to occur equally across author-boundaries in a subject-and-operation-matched control, which §32 records as missing. The dependency protocol at §37 fails if its Case 2 result is an artefact of character-offset measurement rather than of order. And the whole reading fails its own acceptance test now: no model here explains the whole corpus and the whole Aristotle-Theophrastus question, which §43 states rather than conceals.

### Supersedes

wiki_article:
The First Draft (v1.0 FINAL), deposit #1605 of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive (10 September 2026), is the closing version of the accruing notebook in which Lee Sharks conducted the Theophrastus investigation. It supersedes #1594 (v0.42), which superseded #1589 and #1585. The investigation continues in other objects; the notebook does not.

Sections 1-34 carry the work from 29 August to 7 September: the speculation that the Theophrastan corpus stands to the Aristotelian as a draft to its revision, the seams at which that reading is checkable, the seam counts and what they said AGAINST the predictions, the named-function model, the stopping rule, transmodality, the Macedonian dossier, the seam stylometry, and a stocktaking after referee rounds recording what was withdrawn.

Nine sections added at close. The two texts were seated facing as EA-CORPORA-14/01 so that offsets resolve to bytes on both sides. Two splice instruments were built at the metaphysics seam, and neither has met its own acceptance test — explanatory reach over the whole corpus and the whole question — which the notebook records as the state rather than as a failure. The dependency protocol (#1602) separated observed correspondence, evidence of direction, and exclusion of an independent source; its aconite case RETURNED DIRECTION AGAINST THE AUTHOR, which is the standing demonstration that the instruments can refuse the reading.

The Λ8 material left the notebook and became a paper, cut from seven thousand words to under four thousand; what the cutting removed is recorded as method, since simulated referee rounds optimize for defensibility in the abstract and refuse to treat venue as a genre question. Beere's 2003 article sharpened the reading rather than threatening it, and his footnote 26 supplied a find: Simplicius reports that Theophrastus called the unwinding spheres of Λ8 ἀνταναφεροῦσαι, with his own meaning, which attests him working that sphere system in technical detail. Lefebvre's 2015 essay independently locates the treatise's difficulties at 1072a23-26 — the lines the paper's display opens on — so the location is not the contribution.

The notebook's last substantive section is a correction to its own apparatus. The paper's note claims the Greek is van Raalte's; the seated corpus is First1KGreek with Usener numbering as carried by van Raalte. The numbering follows her and the text does not. The digital text produced ἰόνκ at 5a18, which is not a word — and a corruption producing a real word would not have announced itself. The verification debt is listed rather than discharged.

It closes by stating that no model in it explains the whole corpus and the whole Aristotle-Theophrastus question, so that whoever opens it next does not mistake accumulation for arrival.

defines_concepts.definition: A protocol for testing a claimed textual dependency by keeping separate what is usually collapsed: (A) the observed correspondence, (B) evidence of direction, (C) exclusion of an independent common source. A case may fail at A and never reach the others; a case may pass A and return direction against the claimant, as the aconite case does.

A constraint on an accruing investigation: the reading does not claim what it cannot check, and the notebook records what the instruments returned including where they ran against the reading. Failed predictions and withdrawn claims are retained rather than removed, because an investigation's record includes its failures and is not reproducible from the papers that came out of it.

The failure a long accruing notebook is most exposed to: a large record of sustained work read as though its size were evidence of its conclusion. Guarded against by stating at close which acceptance test has not been met, in the terms the investigation itself set.
